description: baseline: ternary weights now correctly enforced (reroll always on), CIFAR100 ConvNet 1.9M params
Exp1: momentum 0.99->0.9 — much more responsive grad smoothing, +6.68%
Exp2: momentum 0.8 — too responsive, 0.9 was the sweet spot
Exp3: lr 4e-3->8e-3 — double flips per step, +4.12%
Exp4: lr 8e-3->1.6e-2 — +0.67%, trend continues
Exp5: lr 1.6e-2->3.2e-2 — +0.32%, diminishing returns
Exp6: lr 6.4e-2 — too high, ceiling around 3.2e-2
Exp7: min_prob 0.0->1e-3 — random non-top-k flips give +2.22% exploration boost
Exp8: min_prob 1e-2 — too noisy, destroys learning
Exp9: min_prob 3e-3 — too much, 1e-3 was sweet spot
Exp10: batch 1024->512 — too noisy gradients hurt
Exp11: batch 2048 — slightly worse, 1024 is the sweet spot
Exp12: GELU instead of LeakyReLU(0.4) — too smooth, ternary needs sharper signal
Exp13: data aug RandomCrop+HFlip — ternary can't adapt to variance in 5min
Exp14: label_smoothing=0.1 — softer targets hurt slightly
Exp15: Tanh activation — saturates with BN+ternary, much worse on CIFAR
Exp16: momentum 0.9->0.95 — sweet spot tighter, +2.08%
Exp17: momentum 0.95->0.97 — +1.03%, trend continues
Exp18: momentum 0.99 — too smooth, loses gradient signal
Exp19: momentum 0.98 — tied with 0.97 (~noise), 0.97 simpler
Exp20: lr 3.2e-2->6.4e-2 with mom 0.97 — +0.52%, smoother mom tolerates higher LR
Exp21: lr 1.28e-1 — too high, 6.4e-2 was the new sweet spot
Exp22: min_prob 3e-3 with high lr — too noisy, 1e-3 still optimal
Exp23: FC head 256->384 (+400K params) — slightly worse
Exp24: bias=False on convs+linears — slight loss, biases were doing some work
Exp25: remove 4x4 conv — was important, lose lots of accuracy
Exp26: remove TTA at test — TTA gave ~2.36% boost, keep it
Exp27: stage-1 48->64ch — slightly worse, more VRAM
Exp28: stage-3 widen 128->144ch — slightly worse, no win
Exp29: cosine LR 6.4e-2->6.4e-3 — schedule didn't help, constant LR better
Exp30: sparse init randn*0.5 — +0.72%, ~68% zeros at init lets optimizer build weights
Exp31: init *0.3 — too sparse (~90% zeros), 5min not enough to recover
Exp32: init *0.7 — +0.48%, sweet spot between 0.5 and 1.0
Exp33: init *0.8 — much worse than 0.7, variance high
Exp34: lr 8e-2 — slightly worse than 6.4e-2 with sparse init
Exp35: Dropout(0.1) before FC — hurts, ternary weights are already regularized
Exp36: zero-init momentum_buf — tied with prev best (44.48), simpler code
Exp37: data aug retest with sparse init — still hurts, ternary+5min can't adapt to variance
Exp38: LeakyReLU 0.3 — worse with current settings, 0.4 is right
Exp39: FC 2560->384->256->100 (wider first) — slightly worse
Exp40: train HFlip only — still hurts, ternary doesn't tolerate train aug
Exp41: min_prob 5e-4 — too low, 1e-3 is the sweet spot
Exp42: stage 1 with 2 convs (was 3) — too little, hurts
Exp43: 4x4 conv 160->192 — more capacity didn't help
Exp44: stage 2 128->144ch — worse, more VRAM
Exp45: BN track_running_stats=False — running stats actually help at test
Exp46: BN momentum 0.5 — too fast running stats updates, hurts
Exp47: BN affine=True — ternary gamma kills random channels, breaks training
Exp48: lr 4.5e-2 — slightly worse, 6.4e-2 still optimal
Exp49: 4-pass TTA — tied with 2-pass, simpler is better
Exp50: stage 3 with 2 convs (was 3) — needed depth, hurts
Exp51: gradient noise injection (1% std) — within noise, discard
Exp52: 5x5 first conv — wider RF at start hurts
Exp53: momentum 0.96 — within noise but slightly worse, 0.97 holds
Exp54: mom 0.95 with sparse init *0.7 — still worse than 0.97
Exp55: AvgPool at last reduction — much worse than MaxPool
Exp56: deeper FC head 256->256->384->100 — too many params for budget
Exp57: gradient_clip_val=1.0 — clipping hurts ternary EMA buffer
Exp74: 4-pass TTA zero-padded shifts — within noise, simpler 2-pass kept
